package student_test

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	studenthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

const t14StudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
const t14PathID = "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd"
const t14ItemID = "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee"

type t14Transport func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (transport t14Transport) RoundTrip(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	return transport(request)
}
func t14AssignedPayload() map[string]any {
	content := map[string]any{"title": "  Frozen <>& R1  ", "excerpt": "", "description": "Frozen description."}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal([3]string{content["title"].(string), content["excerpt"].(string), content["description"].(string)})
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return map[string]any{"schema": domain.AssignedLessonContextSchemaVersion, "student_id": t14StudentID, "learning_path_id": t14PathID, "learning_path_item_id": t14ItemID, "course_id": "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", "lesson_id": "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", "lesson_revision_id": "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc", "content_digest": "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), "content": content}
}
func TestT14AssignedClientExactContractAndBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"exact", "schema", "student", "path", "item", "revision", "digest", "missing excerpt", "null excerpt", "private field", "private content", "title bound", "excerpt bound", "description bound", "response bound", "media", "trailing", "invalid UTF8", "missing", "outage", "duplicate identity", "duplicate content", "invalid projection", "ambiguous projection"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			payload := t14AssignedPayload()
			content := payload["content"].(map[string]any)
			status := http.StatusOK
			media := "application/json"
			switch name {
			case "schema":
				payload["schema"] = "other"
			case "student":
				payload["student_id"] = t14ItemID
			case "path":
				payload["learning_path_id"] = t14ItemID
			case "item":
				payload["learning_path_item_id"] = t14PathID
			case "revision":
				payload["lesson_revision_id"] = "2026-10-04T00:00:00Z"
			case "digest":
				payload["content_digest"] = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
			case "missing excerpt":
				delete(content, "excerpt")
			case "null excerpt":
				content["excerpt"] = nil
			case "private field":
				payload["private_answers"] = []string{}
			case "private content":
				content["private_answers"] = []string{}
			case "title bound":
				content["title"] = strings.Repeat("界", 1001)
			case "excerpt bound":
				content["excerpt"] = strings.Repeat("界", 4001)
			case "description bound":
				content["description"] = strings.Repeat("a", (1<<20)+1)
			case "media":
				media = "text/plain"
			case "invalid projection":
				status = http.StatusBadRequest
			case "ambiguous projection":
				status = http.StatusConflict
			case "missing":
				status = http.StatusNotFound
			case "outage":
				status = http.StatusServiceUnavailable
			}
			if name == "title bound" || name == "excerpt bound" || name == "description bound" {
				encoded, _ := json.Marshal([3]string{content["title"].(string), content["excerpt"].(string), content["description"].(string)})
				digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
				payload["content_digest"] = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
			}
			data, err := json.Marshal(payload)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			body := string(data)
			if name == "duplicate identity" {
				body = strings.Replace(body, `"student_id":`, `"student_id":"`+t14StudentID+`","student_id":`, 1)
			}
			if name == "duplicate content" {
				body = strings.Replace(body, `"excerpt":""`, `"excerpt":"","excerpt":""`, 1)
			}
			if name == "response bound" {
				body += strings.Repeat(" ", 2<<20)
			}
			if name == "trailing" {
				body += "{}"
			}
			if name == "invalid UTF8" {
				body = strings.Replace(body, "Frozen description.", string([]byte{0xff}), 1)
			}
			client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: "http://student.invalid", InternalToken: "shared-read-token", LearningWorkspaceToken: "different-workspace-token", HTTPClient: &http.Client{Transport: t14Transport(func(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
				require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, request.Method)
				require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/"+t14StudentID+"/learning-paths/"+t14PathID+"/items/"+t14ItemID+"/lesson-context", request.URL.Path)
				require.Equal(t, "shared-read-token", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
				return &http.Response{StatusCode: status, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{media}}, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(body))}, nil
			})}}
			got, err := client.GetAssignedLessonContext(context.Background(), t14StudentID, t14PathID, t14ItemID)
			switch name {
			case "exact":
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, content["title"], got.Content.Title)
				require.Empty(t, got.Content.Excerpt)
			case "missing":
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrLessonContextNotFound)
			case "outage":
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable)
			default:
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext)
			}
		})
	}
}
